youtube.title: Capture tasks and plan projects inside your notes
youtube.summary: Capture a task in one line, see what's due today, and plan a whole project on a board, without leaving your notes.
notYet: On iPhone, notes and files linked to a project don't open from its page yet, and calendar events can't be added to a project there.

scenes.title: Intro
scenes.text: Here's how tasks and projects work in {brand}. Let's start with capturing a task.

scenes.title: Quick capture
scenes.text: Everything starts in the capture bar. Type what you need to do, and add the details as you go. An at sign sets the date, an exclamation mark the priority, a plus picks the project, and a hash adds a tag. Each one turns into a pill, so you can see exactly what you'll get before you press enter.

scenes.title: Repeating tasks
scenes.text: Repeating tasks work the same way. Just write the cadence in plain English. Every Monday, every weekday, or every two weeks.

scenes.title: Today and views
scenes.text: Your tasks are grouped by when they're due. Overdue first, then today, tomorrow, and the rest of the week. And the views up here narrow it down to just today, tomorrow, or the next seven days.

scenes.title: Task details
scenes.text: Click any task to open its details. Give it a start date as well as a due date, and it shows up in Today every day until it's done. Break bigger work into sub-issues, and keep the notes you need linked right next to it.

scenes.title: Project hub
scenes.text: Projects are where tasks meet everything else. Open one from the sidebar, and its hub gathers the tasks, notes and files that belong to it, on one page.

scenes.title: Capture in a project
scenes.text: The capture bar here knows where you are. A task you type lands in this project, and a link you paste becomes a note that's already filed with it.

scenes.title: Board and statuses
scenes.text: Every project can have its own workflow. Switch to the board, and drag a card to move it along. The columns are yours to shape, so they match the way you actually work.

scenes.title: Tasks in notes
scenes.text: And you don't have to leave your notes to plan. Type a checkbox in any note, and it becomes a real task, with its date, project and priority right there on the line.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.text: That's tasks and projects in {brand}. Everything lives on your device, encrypted end to end, and syncs when you want it to. Thanks for watching, and I'll see you in the next one.
